Vignette.title: Vignette & Tourist Tax
Vignette.intro: Work out what your vignette (cruising permit) and tourist tax will cost before you arrive.
Vignette.sourceNote: The vignette fee comes from Article 28 of the Law on Yachts, and the tourist tax from the Decree on Tourist Tax for Nautical Tourism Vessels. You can download both from the <laws>Laws</laws> tab. The Harbour Master's office confirms the final amount when you buy the vignette.

Laws.title: Laws & Regulations
Laws.intro: The official laws, decrees and rulebooks that apply to yachts in Montenegro, grouped by topic and ready to download.

documents.note: Most of these are published in Montenegrin only. Where a law also has an English translation, the Montenegrin text is the legally binding one.

yachts.title: Yachts & Navigation
yachts.description: The boat itself: registration, the vignette, chartering and safe navigation.

border.title: Border, Visas & Cash
border.description: Border checks for crew and guests, who needs a visa, and declaring cash.

customs.title: Customs
customs.description: Bringing a yacht in temporarily, duty-free fuel and supplies, and how customs works.

taxes.title: Taxes
taxes.description: Tourist tax, VAT and VAT refunds.

lawOnYachts.title: Law on Yachts
lawOnYachts.description: The main yacht law: registration, entering, staying in and leaving Montenegrin waters, the vignette, chartering, and fines.

maritimeSafety.title: Law on Safety of Maritime Navigation
maritimeSafety.description: Adopted in December 2025, replacing the 2013 law. Safe navigation and traffic control, Montenegrin-flagged ships and boats and their crews, harbour master's offices, search and rescue, and fines.

borderControl.title: Law on Border Control
borderControl.description: Border checks for vessels: the skipper sends the crew and passenger list to the police at least 24 hours before arrival, reports any crew changes, and gives notice before leaving.

visaRegime.title: Decree on Visa Regime
visaRegime.description: Which nationalities can enter Montenegro without a visa, and for how long. Worth checking for crew and guests.

foreignExchange.title: Law on Current and Capital Transactions with Foreign Countries
foreignExchange.description: Montenegro's foreign exchange law. Among other things, cash above the limit set by the Central Bank has to be declared to customs when you enter or leave.

temporaryAdmission.title: Convention on Temporary Admission (Istanbul Convention)
temporaryAdmission.description: The international convention on bringing goods and means of transport in temporarily without paying import duties and taxes, with Montenegro's ratification law. Annex C covers means of transport, yachts included. The English original and the Montenegrin translation in one file.

shipSupplies.title: Rulebook on Supplies for Vessels and Aircraft in International Traffic
shipSupplies.description: How yachts and ships leaving Montenegro take on duty-free fuel, lubricants and provisions under customs supervision, and the paperwork involved. In force since 2024, replacing the 2006 rulebook.

customsProcedures.title: Decree on Customs Procedures and Formalities
customsProcedures.description: The detailed rules for customs procedures and formalities, temporary admission among them, including checks on baggage aboard pleasure craft. Consolidated text, with amendments up to 2025.

customsService.title: Law on the Customs Service
customsService.description: How the customs service is organised and what customs officers may do, such as checking documents and searching goods, means of transport and people.

touristTax.title: Decree on Tourist Tax for Nautical Tourism Vessels
touristTax.description: The flat-rate tourist tax for yachts and ships, set by boat length and length of stay.

vatLaw.title: Law on Value Added Tax
vatLaw.description: Montenegro's VAT law, including where boat hire is taxed and the right of visitors to a VAT refund on goods they take out of the country. Consolidated text, with amendments up to 2024.

vatRulebook.title: Rulebook on the Application of the VAT Law
vatRulebook.description: The detailed VAT rules, including the conditions for a refund: over €100 per receipt, goods out of Montenegro within three months, and a form stamped by customs. Spare parts fitted to foreign-registered yachts during repairs qualify too. Consolidated text, with amendments up to 2024.

Contractors.title: Contractors
Contractors.intro: Local contractors for yachts in Montenegro, from engine servicing to provisioning and help ashore. Pick a category, then call or email them directly.
Contractors.marinaNote: Berthed in a marina? Check with the marina office before a contractor starts work on board. Some marinas, Porto Montenegro among them, require contractors to announce their work in advance.
